faqs.question: How do I check if my charger is BIS certified?
faqs.answer: Look for the Standard Mark/QR code on the product, then verify the R-number on the BIS CRS portal to confirm it's currently valid.

faqs.question: Which standard applies to LED lamps?
faqs.answer: IS 16102 (Part 1) — Self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting. Mandatory certification under CRS.
